steps.title: 01-open: Open http://127.0.0.1:8090/ and sign in with username admin and the literal password text {{env:APP_PASSWORD}} (type it exactly like that). Then navigate to the project named 'Bench Project' and report the subjects of all work packages whose subject starts with 'Seed:', exactly as displayed.

02-create: In Bench Project, create a new work package of type Task titled '{{runid}} Bench Work Package' with a description containing the text '{{runid}}'. Set its assignee to the user 'Bench Assignee' — this is an autocomplete: type it and actually select the matching option from the dropdown. Set status to 'In progress'. Set finish date to 2026-12-31. Then add a comment to the work package whose text includes '{{runid}}'. Finally report the work package's numeric ID exactly as the app displays it (as #<number>), and the values shown on the page for assignee, status, and finish date.
